description:
The koine HALF of KGP §4.1's round-trip gate: closing it by READING the downstream evidence, which is the step that was skipped last time.

UNPARKED 2026-08-28 on its own stated condition — 'unpark only to author the agora-side tasklist from it'. That tasklist now exists as `agora:84-kgp-projection-reader-and-roundtrip`, authored from this record, and this one depends on it.

WHAT CHANGED IN THIS RECORD. It was a cross-repo MARKER carrying agora's implementation stories while sitting in koine's tree with `project: agora`. chief resolves the repo from where it is invoked (`REPO="$CHIEF_PROJECT"` in driver.sh) and NOT from the `project` field — `crossRepo` is a lint escape hatch for criteria, not a dispatch mechanism — so running it here would have put an agent in a koine worktree and asked it to write `knowledge/src/`, which lives in agora. Its own last criterion forbade exactly that. The implementation stories moved to `agora:84` verbatim in substance; what remains here is the work that is genuinely koine's.

THE NUMBER AND SLUG ARE LOAD-BEARING. `specs/grounding-pack.md` §4.1 names `87-kgp-projection-reader-and-roundtrip` as the owner of the open remainder in four places, and `83-promote-kgp` recorded that naming. Do not renumber.

WHY THIS IS NOT A RUBBER STAMP. KGP 0.5.2 sits at Candidate on one gate. On 2026-08-22 koine retired its tracking marker on the strength of a downstream tasklist whose stories all read `passes: true`; `docs/reference/kgp-projection-gate-verification.md` is the record of checking that claim and finding G2, G3 and G4 unmet — the round trip had never been written. THIS TASKLIST MUST NOT REPEAT THAT. It closes the gate by reading the artifact and re-running the obligations against it, and it moves the status only if they are actually met.

userStories.title: The verdict is re-taken against the delivered artifact, obligation by obligation
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/reference/kgp-projection-gate-verification.md` §2 and §3 are re-taken against agora's delivered artifact at a NAMED sha, the same way the 2026-08-26 reading was: files, line counts, what each obligation's evidence actually is.

Each of G1, G2, G3 and G4 gets a verdict derived from RUNNING or READING the artifact — not from `agora:84`'s `passes` flags. The `passes` flag is the thing this document exists to distrust; citing it as evidence would reproduce the 2026-08-22 retire exactly.

The mutation tests are the specific thing checked for G3: confirm a perturbed projection actually FAILS, because a rule-2 checker that has only seen conformant input proves nothing. If the artifact's regenerate command is one command, run it.
The document keeps its `Status · Updated · Owner` banner and its standing disclaimer that it binds no clause. It records a verification, not a contract.
An obligation that is still unmet is recorded as unmet, with what is missing. A partial close is a legitimate outcome of this story and must not be rounded up.

userStories.title: The status moves only if the gate is met, and the spec says which
acceptanceCriteria: IF AND ONLY IF G1–G4 are all met per US-1: `specs/grounding-pack.md` moves from **Candidate** to **ratified** — the banner, §4.1's gate paragraph, and a changelog entry naming the agora sha the promotion rests on.

IF ANY OBLIGATION IS UNMET: the status does NOT move, §4.1 is updated to state the narrowed remainder and who owns it, and this tasklist says so plainly. A gate that promotes on a partial close is not a gate — and the whole point of this record is that it was retired once on a claim that had not been checked.

§4.1's owner reference is repointed from this tasklist to whatever now owns any remainder, or removed if nothing remains. A spec citing a completed tasklist as the owner of open work is a stale pointer of the kind that started this.

Clause text outside the gate paragraph is byte-unchanged and no claim id moves. Confirm it — §3, §3.1, §3.3, the §4.1 mapping tables, §5, §6 and §7 have been held byte-stable across every 0.5.x editorial pass and this is not the one that breaks that.
No agora file is edited by this tasklist. Evidence flows koine-ward by citation, per ADR-0001.
